PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Technology Professional with 9+ years of experience currently serving as Technology Lead with prior experience as Software Engineer, Network/Application Administrator and Technical Support.

Strong expertise in software engineering, application development, system architecture, and technical leadership, with experience delivering scalable enterprise and government applications. Proven skills in system design, performance optimization, requirements analysis, code reviews, mentoring, team leadership, and end-to-end SDLC delivery.

Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science & Engineering(Part-Time), with research focused on OCR, computer vision, deep learning, and character recognition. Brings a combination of software engineering leadership and applied AI/ML research expertise.

CORE SKILLS Languages: C#, Python, JavaScript, PHP, Java, SQL Backend & Frameworks: .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST APIs, Node.js Frontend: React.js, next.js, JavaScript Architecture: Microservices, System Design, Software Architecture, API Design, Design Patterns Databases: SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, Docker, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, CI/CD AI/ML: LLMs, Generative AI, Ollama, OpenAI API, PyTorch, OpenCV, OCR, Deep Learning, Transfer Learning

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Technology Lead | Knowext Inc., Montreal, Canada - Remote September 2023 – Present



Lead software engineering activities across application development, technical design, system enhancement, and production support.

Design backend services and APIs using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, and cloud technologies. • Contribute to system architecture, microservices, API design, scalability, and performance optimization.

Conduct code reviews, mentor developers, and promote engineering standards and maintainable development practices.

Gather requirements and collaborate with stakeholders throughout the SDLC, including design, development, deployment, and production support.

Support automated deployment workflows using GitHub Actions and CI/CD.

Network Administrator | CDAC – RIMS Imphal November 2020 – June 2023

Managed infrastructure and application environments for a statewide Learning Management System supporting medical education.

Performed monitoring, troubleshooting, system maintenance, access control, and technical support. • Supported application availability, security, and data integrity across the platform.

Software Engineer | Cubeten (Govt. Empanelled) July 2019 – October 2020

Developed and maintained state-level digital platforms using .NET, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL, and Web APIs.

• Contributed to the ILP Manipur Online Portal and Tengbang COVID-19 Support Portal, including

backend development, APIs, database operations, and application workflows.

• Optimized SQL queries, API logic, and data workflows and supported end-to-end SDLC activities.

Associate Software Developer | Mobimp January 2019 – June 2019

Developed application features, integrated APIs, improved UI responsiveness, and resolved software defects.

Participated in Agile sprints and delivered iterative production improvements.

Technical Support / Web Application Maintainer | BuyBuy Manipur (Part Time) August 2016 – January 2019

Maintained web application content, inventory, pricing, and operational workflows. • Performed application monitoring, troubleshooting, and backend maintenance.

KEY PROJECTS AI ENGINEERING & GENERATIVE AI PROJECTS Python | FastAPI | React/Next.js | LLMs | Ollama | OpenAI API | REST APIs | Git/GitHub

Built end-to-end AI applications integrating LLMs with modern software architectures, including FastAPI backends and React/Next.js frontends. Integrated local LLMs using Ollama and explored hosted LLM/API-based integration.

• Applied modular architecture, API design, frontend/backend integration, and version-controlled development to AI applications.

NLUP ENGINE — KNOWLEDGE EXTRACTION SYSTEM Document Processing | Regular Expressions | Rule-Based Extraction | SQL

Developed a document-processing workflow for converting unstructured documents in multiple



formats into structured data. Implemented rule-based information extraction using regular expressions, followed by structured database storage and retrieval.

Designed an AI/NLP enhancement approach combining deterministic rules with AI for document classification, semantic extraction, entity recognition, normalization, and validation.

Campusoft — School Management System .NET | SQL Server | JavaScript | Web APIs

Contributed to a multi-module platform supporting 30+ educational institutions, including feature development, performance, usability, and maintenance.

ILP Manipur Online Portal .NET | Web APIs | SQL Server | JavaScript

Developed and enhanced functionality for a government online permit platform. • Contributed to backend development, API integration, database operations, and digital permit workflows. Supported deployment and production maintenance of the platform.



Tengbang COVID-19 Support Portal .NET | Web APIs | SQL Server | JavaScript

Contributed to the rapid development and delivery of a statewide public assistance platform during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Developed application functionality, APIs, database operations, and integration components.

Manipur Education College Management Software .NET | SQL Server | JavaScript

Delivered feature enhancements and application improvements for education management workflows. Improved application usability and supported ongoing application maintenance and development.



RESEARCH & PUBLICATIONS PHD RESEARCH(Ongoing) — COMPUTER VISION, OCR & DEEP LEARNING(Ongoing) Title : Development of a Unified Framework for the Recognition of Printed and Handwritten Manipuri Script using OCR and Deep Learning Techniques. Manipur Institute of Technology, Manipur University | 2024 – Present

Conducting research on a unified framework for recognition of printed and handwritten Manipuri script using OCR and deep learning techniques.

Developed image preprocessing, dataset preparation, and augmentation workflows for handwritten



character recognition. Implemented transfer learning using PyTorch and evaluated AlexNet, ResNet-50, MobileNetV3, and EfficientNetV2.

Research areas include computer vision, OCR, image classification, deep learning, transfer learning, and pattern recognition.

PUBLICATIONS: “A Transfer Learning Approach for the Recognition of Handwritten Meetei/Meitei Mayek Digits” Conference Paper | 2025

“Recognition of Handwritten Meetei/Meitei Mayek Digits using Transfer Learning Approach” Journal Manuscript | 2026

“Performance Evaluation of Transfer Learning Architectures for Handwritten Meetei/Meitei Mayek Digit Recognition” Journal Manuscript | 2026

EDUCATION PhD in Computer Science & Engineering (Pursuing Part-Time) Manipur Institute of Technology, Manipur University — 2024 – Present

M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering Manipur Institute of Technology, Manipur University — 2019 (89%)

B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering Shridevi Institute of Engineering & Technology, VTU Belgaum — 2016

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAINING

National Conference on Emerging Trends in Engineering Science & Management • Workshop on Developments and Potential Applications of Superconductors • Webinar Lead: “Supplementing Medical Education with E-Technology”

ACHIEVEMENTS

Successfully deployed ILP Manipur Online Platform at the Chief Minister’s Secretariat.

• Contributed to Tengbang COVID-19 platform used statewide during the pandemic. • Contributed to the development of Campusoft, supporting 30+ educational institutions. • Delivered webinar sessions promoting e-learning adoption and technical literacy.
